parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
  product_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  scent_notes TEXT,
  size_ml INTEGER CHECK (size_ml IS NULL OR size_ml > 0),
  price_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price_bdt >= 0),
  stock_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0),
  image_url TEXT,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  auto_publish BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_products_sku ON products (lower(sku));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_products_name ON products (lower(product_name));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_products_active ON products (active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
  customer_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('facebook','instagram')),
  platform_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  customer_name TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  consent_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (consent_status IN ('unknown','granted','revoked')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT ux_customers_platform_user UNIQUE (platform, platform_user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
  conversation_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('facebook','instagram')),
  platform_conversation_id TEXT,
  last_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','waiting_customer','waiting_human','closed')),
  order_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (order_state IN ('none','draft','awaiting_confirmation','confirmed','cancelled')),
  assigned_agent TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_conversations_platform_conv ON conversations (platform, platform_conversation_id) WHERE platform_conversation_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversations_customer ON conversations (customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversations_status ON conversations (status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  message_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id BIGINT REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id),
  platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('facebook','instagram')),
  direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('inbound','outbound')),
  sender_id TEXT,
  message_text TEXT,
  attachment_url TEXT,
  intent TEXT,
  processing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' CHECK (processing_status IN ('received','processing','processed','sent','failed','ignored','escalated')),
  platform_message_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_messages_platform_msgid ON messages (platform, platform_message_id, direction) WHERE platform_message_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_messages_conversation ON messages (conversation_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_messages_created ON messages (created_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS webhook_events (
  id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL,
  external_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_hash TEXT,
  processing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' CHECK (processing_status IN ('received','routed','processed','ignored','failed')),
  received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  error_message TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT ux_webhook_events_platform_event UNIQUE (platform, external_event_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_webhook_events_status ON webhook_events (processing_status, received_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT ('ANF-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 10))),
  customer_id BIGINT REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
  conversation_id BIGINT REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id),
  platform TEXT CHECK (platform IN ('facebook','instagram')),
  customer_name TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  subtotal_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (subtotal_bdt >= 0),
  delivery_fee_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (delivery_fee_bdt >= 0),
  total_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_bdt >= 0),
  payment_method TEXT,
  payment_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (payment_status IN ('pending','paid','failed','refunded')),
  order_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (order_status IN ('draft','confirmed','processing','shipped','delivered','cancelled')),
  source TEXT,
  sheet_sync_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (sheet_sync_status IN ('pending','synced','failed')),
  sheet_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  idempotency_key TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_orders_idempotency ON orders (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_orders_customer ON orders (customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_orders_conversation ON orders (conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_orders_status_created ON orders (order_status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_orders_sheet_sync ON orders (sheet_sync_status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
  order_item_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id),
  sku TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
  size_ml INTEGER CHECK (size_ml IS NULL OR size_ml > 0),
  unit_price_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_bdt >= 0),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  line_total_bdt NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_bdt >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_order_items_order ON order_items (order_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_order_items_product ON order_items (product_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS faqs (
  faq_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  category TEXT,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,
  answer TEXT NOT NULL,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_faqs_active_category ON faqs (active, category);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS store_settings (
  setting_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  setting_value TEXT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_queue (
  content_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  source_file_id TEXT,
  file_hash TEXT,
  product_id BIGINT REFERENCES products(product_id),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('facebook','instagram')),
  caption TEXT,
  hashtags TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','review','approved','publishing','published','failed','rejected')),
  approval_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  approved_by TEXT,
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  external_post_id TEXT,
  permalink TEXT,
  error_message TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_content_queue_file_channel ON content_queue (source_file_id, channel) WHERE source_file_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_content_queue_hash_channel ON content_queue (file_hash, channel) WHERE file_hash IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_content_queue_status ON content_queue (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_content_queue_product ON content_queue (product_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_errors (
  error_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  workflow_name TEXT,
  node_name TEXT,
  execution_id TEXT,
  execution_url TEXT,
  error_message TEXT,
  related_order_id TEXT,
  related_content_id BIGINT,
  retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retry_count >= 0),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_workflow_errors_created ON workflow_errors (created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_workflow_errors_execution ON workflow_errors (execution_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_reports (
  report_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  report_date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  metrics JSONB NOT NULL,
  report_text TEXT,
  notification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (notification_status IN ('pending','sent','failed')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
